dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: Nara Khayyam... I had forgotten his name. He cannot see us anymore, right...?

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: I can't meet him again, but I will use my singing to tell the forest, and tell the wind, to keep traces of him.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakin
dialogues.text: His name will not be forgotten again this way.
